title: Voice joins the system strip: a bounded probe proves each provider, priced
test_cases_note: 8 acceptance cases carried by 23 node:test cases (mint-error 6, readiness 9, failover-counts 2, route 6); all 23 red before (the modules did not exist), all green after. Plus the rate-limit contract row (283/283).
gates_note: tsc: 0 errors on this card's paths (the only whole-tree error is the untracked kpi-sim/runs copy tree). perf=1 on committed HEAD is NOT this card: git-archive of HEAD with vs without this card's files measured app/page.tsx 1448/9214 -> 1450/9226; only +2 modules / +12 KB was raised (f2f4ade69, 1447/9221 -> 1449/9233). The committed tree without this card was already 1448 > 1447 (a sibling's committed +1 module, remaining finding: page.tsx 1450 vs 1449). constitution=1 is the expected route-auth-posture finding, see notes. test:unit 10995/10995 on the working tree.
deviations_from_card: (1) Critic revision applied: no 'free/zero-cost' claim anywhere; title, commit, docs and the Check-now tooltip + visible hint say a probe is a credential mint that opens no conversation, may spend one mint per paid provider, is operator-triggered only, never on page load, and limited to 6 per 10 min per IP. (2) Auth: GET/POST call requireHomeOrgReader (as the card said); POST additionally asks requireCapabilityCoded('pipeline:write', requireCapability) because route-capability-coverage requires every mutating verb to ask a capability. (3) KP_OFFLINE refuses the probe with a NEW refusal code VOICE_READINESS_OFFLINE (503), catalogued in 4 locales with VOICE_READINESS_FAILED; GET carries offline:true so the button is not offered. (4) Case 3 adapter tests live in a new mint-error.test.ts (not openai-session.test.ts); case 8 lives in app/_lib/db/interviews-failover-counts.test.ts (the unit-db import must be first, which readiness.test.ts does not need). (5) Commit shape: shared-surface commit (codes+catalogs) first, then feat (code+tests together: the tests import modules that did not exist, so a tests-only commit could not be green), then the lock-guarded docs+contract+api-reference commit, then the perf raise. (6) Price source is resolved in readiness.ts (voiceBilling) rather than by editing minute-prices.ts (outside the write set); a drift-guard test pins voiceBilling().usdPerMin === voiceMinutePriceUsd() for 8 raw override shapes x both providers. (7) Probe memory is keyed by a sha256 of the provider's config env, so a rotated key reads 'unchecked' at once rather than a stale green for the TTL.
notes: ROUTE AUTH (constitution route-auth-posture at app/api/voice/readiness/route.ts:1, blocking in the lens, needs a coordinator waiver): the route calls requireHomeOrgReader() (which calls requireOperator() internally, then answers a coded 403 capability 'deployment:read' to another org's member) on GET and POST, and POST also calls requireCapabilityCoded('pipeline:write', requireCapability). The lens regex only matches the literal name requireOperator; auth was not reshaped for it. Suggested trailer: `Gate-exemption: route-auth-posture at app/api/voice/readiness/route.ts — gated by requireHomeOrgReader (wraps requireOperator, deployment:read) and POST by requireCapabilityCoded(pipeline:write); not on public-routes`. Not on public-routes.ts. LOCK ANOMALY: at my first lock session (catalogs + api-response) the lock dir I had just created was gone when I went to rmdir it; a sibling (schedule-interview-prep, commit 2c2148dbc landed its planDiff catalog keys while my lock was held) appears to have removed it. My catalog commit 8cd147b49 was built from HEAD blobs + my insertions via update-index and is verified additive-only (their planDiff keys intact). PERF: the remaining app/page.tsx 1450 vs 1449 module finding is a sibling's committed +1 (present in HEAD without this card). Route graphs: this card adds ~2 KB to routes that reach the voice adapters (mint-error.ts), all within ceilings. Loop closed: the Check-now button is offered only when GET says canProbe (can('pipeline:write')) and not offline, the same predicates POST refuses on; candidate-facing availability reads (GET /api/interview/connect, intake voice-connect GET) deliberately stay env-level (a candidate page must never trigger a mint) and no stored status or refusal on them changed. No read->write added: the route writes only the in-process probe memory (last-writer-wins) and the limiter; countInterviewFailovers is read-only and workspace-scoped on the existing interview_sessions scope (no tenancy-manifest change). Minted credentials never leave probeVoiceProviders (route test asserts clientSecret, signedUrl and callsUrl absent from the body). loop_open: none. (Future work, not an open loop: connect/route.ts could read VoiceMintError.cause to skip a failover on 'auth'; nothing today disagrees with the new rule.)
